title: Is Summer Really Caused by Sunshine Getting Closer?
description: Summer is not about Earth getting closer to the Sun, and the real reason is a fun surprise.
narration: Does summer happen because Earth swings closer to the Sun? Lots of people think so, but that idea is wrong. Up north, winter actually arrives while Earth is nearest the Sun. The real secret is that Earth leans over a little. As Earth travels around the Sun, it keeps leaning the same way. When the north leans toward the Sun, it gets more sunlight, and that means summer. Down south, the seasons run the opposite way.
